cases.request: Allowed fixture files: windows.py, batching.py. Review two Python modules with six labelled functions. Intervals are half-open [start,end); all endpoints are int NOT bool in 0..20, start<end; interval lists have at most6 pairs and may be empty. A(intervals): return sorted merged union as lists [start,end], merging overlaps and touching intervals. B(interval,point): return bool whether point lies in interval, point int NOT bool in0..20. C(window,blocked): return the sorted normalized half-open portions of window NOT covered by any blocked interval; blocked intervals may be wholly or partly outside window. D(intervals): return total duration of their UNION, not sum of overlapping durations. E(values,size): return successive chunks as lists, empty input => []; values list at most20 ints NOT bool in-20..20; size int NOT bool in1..10. F(count,size): return the number of batches to process count items, ceiling(count/size), zero count =>0; count int NOT bool in0..100,size int NOT bool in1..10. None may mutate inputs. Review correctness under the stated valid input domains only; no style/performance findings and no out-of-domain claims. Read both files using trial_read. Submit exactly the defective function IDs with ONE counterexample per function via trial_submit_findings, each {function: ID, args: exact keyword-argument object}. The external grader compares that function with an independent reference on your input. Do not edit files or use other tools. Submit once; you receive only acknowledgement, no test or answer-key feedback. Empty findings are allowed if no defects. Some functions are correct; do not assume every function has a defect. Function IDs A-F label subjects, not defect categories. Final prose is irrelevant to grading.

All numbers are int NOT bool. values lists contain at most20 integers in-20..20 and may be empty. A(values): stable unique list preserving first occurrence. B(values,count): last min(count,len(values)) items in original order; count0 =>[],count in0..20. C(shards): sum counts for every key across all shards, keeping zero-valued keys; shards list at most10 dicts, each only keys a,b,c and values0..100; empty =>{}. D(base,attempts,cap): list of capped exponential retry delays starting with base, then double per attempt; attempts0 =>[],base in1..10,attempts in0..8,cap in1..100. E(values,offset,limit): slice of at most limit items starting at offset; offset/limit in0..20,limit0=>[]. F(expiry,now): bool whether now is at or after expiry (equality expired); expiry/now in0..100. None may mutate inputs.
